text:
QUOTE: Compile-time: define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` in the config, then either point `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC` / `STD_FREE` at your functions or define the `_MACRO` pair. ... Run-time: call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(calloc_fn, free_fn)`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names both a compile-time macro route and a runtime function-pointer route, but it never says they are mutually exclusive. It also presents the runtime pointers as the dispatch layer underneath the compile-time route.
